observation.note: Identified the 4 vertical corner edges (length 3.6, matching body height) via inspect_region on a bare-corner vertex with rings=3, distinguishing them from the horizontal top/bottom rim edges (length 3.0 or 2.0).

reason: modest corner softening per reference notes ('not sharp, not heavily rounded')

result_state.note: 2 n-gons appeared -- the top and bottom quad caps each became an 8-sided octagon since all 4 of their corners got clipped by the vertical bevel. Real, expected geometric consequence, not a bug, but this project holds n-gons to zero throughout -- flagged for a follow-up fix (triangulate) rather than accepted silently.
